traceability.notes: All aspects of story 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING are implemented and verified. Each relevant rule (require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation, require-branch-annotation, valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, valid-req-reference) defines specific, contextual error messages using ESLint meta.messages with the placeholders and patterns described in the story. Error severities are configured so that missing annotations and invalid references are errors while format issues are warnings, as confirmed by tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts. The dedicated suite tests/rules/error-reporting.test.ts directly validates REQ-ERROR-SPECIFIC, REQ-ERROR-SUGGESTION, REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT, and REQ-ERROR-LOCATION for require-story-annotation, including suggestion wiring. Additional rule tests confirm correct behavior and error handling for edge cases (filesystem errors, invalid paths, malformed annotations). A fresh npm test run in this assessment shows all these tests passing, so the story’s acceptance criteria and listed requirements remain fully satisfied.
